blocking_gate: Stop before stage 2 on any infrastructure, source, heading, runtime-profile or strict Full/Adaptive safe-completion failure. Retain valid Sector mission failures as measured outcomes.
claim_limit: Finite simulation evidence on seven declared maps. It is not a population or real-world 100% guarantee.
objective: Generate a fresh common Full, canonical Active-Yaw Sector, and velocity-centred Adaptive cohort after applying the bounded 0.6-to-1.2 m certified recovery schedule equally to all three near-hit profiles.
predeclared_metrics: end-to-end mean CPU cores and cumulative CPU core-seconds
Adaptive Full-open transitions and refresh acknowledgements

runtime_contract.profile_scope: identical schedule in current Full, Sector and Adaptive near-hit profiles
runtime_contract.runtime_audit: Every flight must load each of the three bounded-recovery parameters exactly once.

stages.stage2: repetitions 6-10; starts only after the stage-1 gate passes
